paper.title: Reasoning about the Unseen for Efficient Outdoor Object Navigation

evidence.quote: Human intervention is essential for evaluating success across all levels from 1 to 4.
evidence.support_explanation: Human success adjudication necessary; protocol/agreement and counts not specified.

evidence.quote: All of these frontiers are retained in a specialized Frontier Buffer for subsequent reference.
evidence.support_explanation: Within-episode candidate memory, not cross-task self-improvement.

evidence.quote: By projecting multiple forward-looking imaginary branches through iterative queries of LLM_Visionary and LLM_Evaluator
evidence.support_explanation: Future branches are model-generated hypotheses, not actual simulated outcome checks.

evidence.quote: These images are processed by a Vision Language Model (VLM). For the purposes of this study, we employed Kosmos-2
with the localization from on board high resolution RTK-GPS and IMU.
evidence.support_explanation: Precise localization is a deployment prerequisite, not learned from captions.

evidence.quote: T_{max} = 30 minutes, and any experiment time above it is set to failure.
evidence.support_explanation: CASR includes travel+compute under time cap.

evidence.quote: Both baselines are reproductions of existing methods using our graph maps, devoid of depth information.
evidence.support_explanation: Shared graph controls map representation, but no equal model-call budget.
Sim/real SR/OSR/CASR reported without trial denominators.

evidence.quote: to minimize the performance variance attributed to our perception model, we ignored the caption error in this evaluation.
evidence.support_explanation: Ablation uses idealized captions; full-loop real perception not isolated.

evidence.quote: the VLM, upon achieving its goal, often fails to acknowledge it.
evidence.support_explanation: Wrong stop/goal acknowledgment contributes to OSR-SR gap.

evidence.quote: The combination of GPT4 with GPT4 was not explored due to the rate limit constraints of the OpenAI API
evidence.support_explanation: Backbone ablation incomplete and resource limits explicit.
Average four-metric improvement, but not every level; L4 SR .32 vs MCTS .33. This does not contradict the author claim about four averaged metrics.

signatures.object: Outdoor frontier selection and motion harness
signatures.information: N camera directions captioned by Kosmos-2, language goal, episode waypoint graph, physical RTK-GPS/IMU; no depth premap, imagined scenes are not measurements.
signatures.operation: Generate frontiers, imagine multi-branch future scene text, score goal likelihood 1–5, aggregate RRT tree and distance sigmoid; retain alternatives and execute top waypoint with PID.
signatures.output: Selected waypoint, graph and Frontier Buffer
signatures.conditions: Accurate localization/captions and reachable waypoints; L/N/distance heuristics fixed.
signatures.feedback: Real next images after movement; LLM stop check; imagined scene evaluator is a proxy, not sound oracle.
signatures.selection_rule: Max tree Q adjusted by travel penalty; no cross-task acceptance process.
signatures.selection_data: Current episode plus designer-provided few-shot/initializer data; no automatically retained harness changes.
signatures.later_use: Reconsider retained frontiers next navigation step.
signatures.claimed_effect: Better outdoor search SR/OSR and CASR.
signatures.failure_boundary: Hallucinated objects/futures, failed goal acknowledgment, small obstacles and unknown human-label protocol.

claims.setting: AirSim Downtown West, goal levels 1–4, depth-free graph.
claims.selection_vs_test: No declared scene/goal dev split; L ablation uses L1, 15-min cap and ignores captions errors.
claims.result/denominator: Mean SR .51 vs .06 myopic/.47 MCTS; CASR .42 vs .04/.10; no trial n.
claims.counterevidence: Average gains do not imply all task levels improve: L4 SR .32 vs MCTS .33. The author four-averaged-metrics claim is consistent with Table I; no contradiction is inferred. Mean SR .04 gap has no task-level uncertainty, and ablation idealizes captions.
claims.allowed_conclusion: Descriptive mean gain and compute tradeoff, not significant or uniform superiority.

claims.text: Method generalizes to physical quadruped outdoor navigation.
claims.counterevidence: Human success protocol, repetitions and per-task counts absent; wrong stopping remains.
claims.allowed_conclusion: Author-reported physical deployment, not evidence-level transfer or calibrated goal detection.

assessment.strongest_supported_claim: Authors report closed-loop outdoor waypoint navigation with VLM text and LLM imagined lookahead; same-graph comparisons show descriptive SR/CASR gains over myopic evaluation, but principal trial counts, goal-label audit and heldout provenance are absent.
unresolved: No main/real trial denominators or human adjudication protocol.
Not uniformly better across goal levels; no confidence for mean SR .04 difference. Table I does support improvement in all four averaged metrics.
Imagined futures and stopping not independently calibrated.
